answer: Persistent Reputation Carryover Ledger: each identity's history follows it across every interaction, so a fresh clone starts at zero and must earn trust again. A whisper of misbehavior in one identity ripples into every future quote, raising its costs. Cloning therefore duplicates the full canyon of accrued verification work, not just a fee: an attacker pays the entire re-earning cost per identity, making honesty cheaper than duplication.
